evidence.detail: R115 ScriptPacketDispatcher registers rs/n/c/b/d directly as exact ScriptPacket ID 10.

The handler controls rs/n/c/b/a, already recovered in R3 as GladiatorsVindicationWorldEventInterface from the exact title "Gladiator's Vindication (World Event)", event-duration/progress vocabulary and event/task resources.

All selector branches 0 through 10 stay on the recovered world-event interface: reset and populate event task/option rows, update progress and visibility, select the current event option, rebuild/reflow the dynamic option list, update scroll position, clear current selection, and update the selected option's dynamic text.
Selector 2 reads a packet integer as percent-hundredths, scales it across the 367-pixel progress surface, and rewrites widget 57222 with the exact 'event/task 2' resource.

Selectors target the same 56997-57223 interface widget range and rs/n/c/b state used by the recovered World Event surface; exact target strings/resources include event/task, event/task 1-3, 'Event duration ends in:', progress bar text, selectable buttons and option text.

candidates.note: GladiatorsVindicationWorldEventInterfacePacketHandler is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for ScriptPacket 10. Every selector is anchored to the already-recovered GladiatorsVindicationWorldEventInterface and its dynamic task/progress/selection widgets. Confidence is 0.998.
